name: ReceiptBatch_TransactionByUser
command:
SELECT  trxns.TRX_ID AS TRANSACTION_ID,
        trxns.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT AS TRANSACTION_AMOUNT,
        trxns.FOLIO_TYPE AS TRANSACTION_FOLIO_EXPENSE_TYPE,
            CASE
        /* Airfare */
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                 UPPER(NVL(trxns.merchant_name1, '')),
                 'AIRLINE|AIRWAYS|AIRLINES|AIR FARE|TRAVEL AGENCY|TRAVEL AGENT|LUFTHANSA|DELTA|UNITED|AMERICAN AIR|SOUTHWEST|MEXICANA|USAIRWAY|NORTHWEST|BRITISH AIR|AIR FRANCE|KLM|EL AL'
             )
            THEN 'Airfare'

        /* Car Rental */
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                 UPPER(NVL(trxns.merchant_name1, '')),
                 'RENT[- ]?A[- ]?CAR|RENTAL CAR|CAR RENTAL|AVIS|HERTZ|ENTERPRISE|BUDGET|DOLLAR RENT|NATIONAL CAR|ALAMO|SIXT'
             )
            THEN 'Car Rental'

        /* Entertainment */
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                 UPPER(NVL(trxns.merchant_name1, '')),
                 'CINEMA|MOVIE|THEATER|THEATRE|CONCERT|CLUB|NIGHTCLUB|AMUSEMENT|PARK|DISNEY|MUSEUM|GALLERY|EXHIBITION|CASINO|BOWLING|STADIUM|ARENA|TICKETS|EVENTBRITE|TICKETMASTER'
             )
            THEN 'Entertainment'

        /* Hotel */
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                 UPPER(NVL(trxns.merchant_name1, '')),
                 'HOTEL|MOTEL|INN|LODGE|RESORT|SUITES|MARRIOTT|HYATT|HILTON|HOLIDAY INN|FOUR SEASONS|SHERATON|WESTIN|CONRAD|EMBASSY SUITES|BEST WESTERN|RADISSON|COURTYARD|HAMPTON INN'
             )
            THEN 'Hotel'

        /* Meals */
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                 UPPER(NVL(trxns.merchant_name1, '')),
                 'RESTAURANT|GRILL|CAFE|CAFÉ|BISTRO|BUFFET|PIZZA|BURGER|SUSHI|STEAK|STEAKHOUSE|BBQ|BARBEQUE|DELI|DINER|MCDONALD|STARBUCKS|WENDY|HOOTERS|SUBWAY|TACO|CHILI|OLIVE GARDEN|RED LOBSTER|LOBSTER HOUSE|CHINESE FOOD'
             )
            THEN 'Meals'

        /* Taxis */
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                 UPPER(NVL(trxns.merchant_name1, '')),
                 'TAXI|TAXIS|UBER|LYFT|LIMO|LIMOUSINE|TRANSIT|METRO|RAIL|BAHN|BUS|SHUTTLE'
             )
            THEN 'Taxis'

        /* Telephone Calls */
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                 UPPER(NVL(trxns.merchant_name1, '')),
                 'AT%T|VERIZON|VODAFONE|ORANGE|TELECOM|TELEFONICA|TELEPHONE|PHONE CARD|CALLING CARD|SBC|SPRINT|T-MOBILE|SFR'
             )
            THEN 'Telephone Calls'

        /* Default */
        ELSE 'Miscellaneous'
    END AS TRANSACTION_EXPENSE_TYPE,
        TO_CHAR(trxns.TRANSACTION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS TRANSACTION_RECEIPT_DATE,
        trxns.MERCHANT_NAME1           AS TRANSACTION_MERCHANT
FROM   ap_credit_card_trxns_all trxns
JOIN   ap_cards_all cards
       ON cards.card_id = trxns.card_id
JOIN   fnd_user fu
       ON fu.employee_id = cards.employee_id
WHERE   fu.user_name = UPPER('${EBS_USER}')
